ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.2.15 (TieJin Modify) 公交车交易触发修复与未完成特化入口禁用。 基于原模组 7 月停更时的 2.2.8 版本继续维护。 修复公交车角色完成商队交易后未启动互动的问题。宠物猫、宠物兔选择项置灰并标注“未完成”，旧档兔子生育模式改为只读。维护者已分别确认有效，包含 2.2.14 及更早版本修复。 旧 RimTalk 兼容已暂停并归档，整个模块将在未来重做。 完整中英双语更新记录见模组目录中的 CHANGELOG.md。
Continues development from the upstream 2.2.8 baseline. Fixes Public Use interactions after caravan trades and disables unfinished specialization selection. Pet Cat and Pet Rabbit choices are disabled and marked Incomplete; saved rabbit birth modes are displayed as read-only. The maintainer has confirmed these changes work. Includes fixes from 2.2.14 and earlier versions. Legacy RimTalk integration is suspended and archived pending a complete redesign. See CHANGELOG.md in the mod folder for the full Chinese and English release notes.
